Ardath is a Persian name derived from the Old Persian word ‘Arda’ meaning mountain or high place, and ‘Daeva’ meaning gods. In Persian mythology, Ardath was a goddess of fertility and motherhood. In Christianity, Ardath may symbolize the mountain of God, symbolizing the spiritual journey towards enlightenment and divine connection.
